products.name: Alaffia EveryDay Coconut Body Wash - Coconut Lime
products.overview: EveryDay Coconut Ultra Hydrating Body Wash is prepared with Certiﬁed Fair Trade virgin coconut oil, shea butter, and antioxidant rich coffee berries to gently cleanse away pollutants & grime. For EveryDay use on dry to extra dry skin.
products.description:
Ethically traded ingredients, sulfate-free and clean. Our EveryDay Coconut Lime Body Wash is handcrafted with fair trade virgin coconut oil, aromatic lime extract, antioxidant-rich coffee berry extract, and fair trade and unrefined shea butter from our cooperatives in West Africa to gently cleanse away pollutants while nourishing and protecting your skin. For daily cleansing. Suitable for normal to very dry skin.
How do we make our body wash? Coconut oil and shea butter are mixed together and heated. A natural saponifier made from ashes of plantain leaves and tree barks is added, then the mixture is cooked over heat, stirring constantly for 30-60 minutes until the hot saponification process is completed. The hot soap is scooped into a large metal bowl, where the soap expands up into a palm-frond basket and cools. Cooled soap is placed onto palm frond mats to dry in the sun. This truly natural liquid hand and body soap is ultra-moisturizing and gentle for skin.

products.description:
Triple milled for a long-lasting, ultra-moisturizing soap. Alaffia’s Authentic African Black Soap is likened to the home remedies of Togolese mamans. It’s made from a centuries-old recipe of handcrafted fair trade and unrefined shea butter and Orangutan-safe West African palm oil†. Saponification is reached by adding potash (made from plantains and leaves) to the hot oils, and then cooking it for six hours. The last step is curing the soap in the sun for three weeks, resulting in a gentle and effective cleanser that clarifies and softens skin. Suitable for any skin type, even the most sensitive. Sulfate-free.
† Our natural West African palm oil is grown and harvested by small-scale farmers in the Maritime region of Togo, from the town of Tsevie to Kpalime. The oil is extracted by our Fair Trade cooperative in Sokodé using traditional methods. When palm oil is grown as an industrial plantation crop, such as in Indonesia and Malaysia on newly cleared rain forests or peat-swamp forests rather than on already degraded land or disused agricultural land, it can contribute to the endangerment of animals such as the Orangutans. However, this is not the case with the small farms that we receive our palm oil from in Africa. Oil palms are native to West Africa and have been grown as part of multi-cropped sustainable small farms for centuries. Furthermore, it is important to point out that Orangutans do not exist at all in Africa.

products.description:
The Best Mineral Sunscreen Stick
Sunscreen battles begone with Baby Face Mineral Sunscreen Face Stick (Broad Spectrum SPF 40) in an easy-to-apply stick that contains organic calendula and soothing organic aloe to keep baby’s skin safe and moisturized. How to Use Baby Mineral Sunscreen
Apply to your face, neck, ears or any spot that needs coverage. If the stick doesn’t glide easily, warm it on the skin first. It is recommended that sunscreen be reapplied every two hours, or less if you’ve been in the water.
Having a light cast from your mineral sunscreen can be helpful because it indicates the presence of physical, non-nano zinc which sits on top of the skin and reflects UV rays, providing immediate, broad-spectrum sun protection.
The light cast is a visual reminder that the sunscreen is forming a protective barrier and can help you know when and where you need to reapply.

Non-nano zinc: No chemical sunscreens, artificial fragrance, or dimethicone.
Pediatrician tested, dermatologist tested and clinically tested for irritation.
Water resistant (40 min), UVA/UVB SPF 40 protection.
NSF/ANSI 305 Certified by Oregon Tilth, Leaping Bunny Certified, and Plastic Neutral.
Rated ONE on the EWG’s Skin Deep Cosmetics Database, the lowest hazard rating a product can achieve.

Size: 90ml
 
You said 67. We said…sure, why not—and made a fragrance that actually makes sense. The mango sensation sold out in hours and now it's back in super limited quantities. 
 
Mango-first, fun-always. Limited Edition Cheirosa 67 is the layered fruity amber perfume mist you asked for (literally). The hand-drawn sunray says it all. Bright and playful, we've captured the easy, unexpected energy of 67 in a bottle. Inside? A juicy burst of mango juice, pear nectar, black currant, and vanilla crème with a warm, intoxicating finish of amber woods. Senseless? Yes. Delicious? Absolutely.
 
Fun fact: To reduce waste and bring this mist to life fast, we repurposed unused Cheirosa 71 bottles just for this drop. Each bottle comes with a custom label applied by hand, so every single one is a little quirky, a little imperfect, and entirely one of a kind.

Notes: Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Patchouli, Coconut

products.description:
The future of sun protection is here.
holi (sun) is a tinted SPF 50+ sunscreen serum that shields, perfects, and nourishes in one effortless step. Powered by 12% non-nano zinc oxide with KLEAIR™ technology, it blocks up to 98% of UV rays and 35% of blue light, while niacinamide works to even skin tone, refine texture, and fight free radical damage. This lightweight, non-toxic formula delivers a veil of breathable coverage with no white cast—just a natural, lit-from-within glow. With its silky tint, holi (sun) doubles as a tinted moisturizer or foundation replacement, blurring imperfections and leaving skin looking effortlessly polished. A hydrating base of plant-derived squalane and fatty acid-rich rice bran extract replenishes moisture, so your skin feels as good as it looks.

Available in 5 blendable, radiance-boosting shades
Ivory: fair complexions
Beige: light complexions
Almond: light to medium complexions
Honey: medium to deep tan complexions 
Espresso: deep to very deep complexions
 

Non-nano 12% zinc oxide provides broad-spectrum SPF 50+ protection, shielding the skin from over 98% of UVA and UVB rays. Zinc oxide’s anti-inflammatory properties aid in reducing redness while its antimicrobial properties soothe the skin and prevent clogged pores.

Forms a shield to block over 35% of blue light (HEVL).

Improves skin texture and reduces the appearance of hyperpigmentation with vitamin B3-rich niacinamide.

Provides lightweight, flexible coverage that moves with the skin throughout the day.

Skincare doesn’t stop at your neck—the rest of your body deserves high-quality ingredients, too. holi (wash) is a luxurious foaming oil body cleanser that doubles as a gentle exfoliant. Provides a lifting and firming effect and reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles with with Cyathea medullaris leaf extract.
